title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PowerEnvelopeProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PowerEnvelopeProfile. A Flexibility Profile described through a Power Envelope Profile. Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerEnvelopeProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasConstraints.description: Relationship. This property relates a Power Envelop Instruction or Profile to the constraints it needs to follow. There are two types of constraints modelled: Power constraints and energy constraints. Relationship to PowerConstraint/EnergyConstraint.

hasPowerEnvelope.description: Relationship. The PEBC.PowerEnvelope(s) that should be followed by the Resource Manager. There shall be at least one PEBC.PowerEnvelope, but at most one PEBC.PowerEnvelope for each Commodity. Relationship to PowerEnvelope.

hasPowerEnvelopeElement.description: Relationship. This property relates a PowerEnvelopeProfile to the various specific PowerEnvelops contained in the profile. Relationship to PowerEnvelope.
